settings.label: Advanced
settings.description: Picture, sound, subtitles, speed and the rest of YouTube's settings

settings.label: Playback Resolution
settings.description:
The most a video plays at; lower where it has nothing this high
[480P] Right for a CRT and a Pi  [1440P] [2160P] Need Video Codec ANY: YouTube has H.264 only up to 1080p

settings.label: Video Codec
settings.description: [H.264] What a Pi decodes in hardware, wherever YouTube has it  [ANY] Whatever looks best, often VP9 or AV1, decoded in software

settings.label: Max Frame Rate
settings.description: [30] 30 fps where a video also has 60: lighter on a Pi

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says

settings.label: Audio Language
settings.description:
The audio track of a video that has several
[ORIGINAL] The one it was made in

settings.label: Subtitles
settings.description: [ON] A video's subtitles in Subtitle Language, where it has them  [WITH AUTO] Also YouTube's automatic captions

settings.label: Sign in
settings.description:
Opens Google's sign-in page full screen, to sign in with a keyboard: YouTube then searches and plays as that account, with fewer bot checks
YouTube can block an account used through yt-dlp: sign in with a spare one
Needs Chromium, or Google Chrome on a Mac

settings.label: Sign out
settings.description: Forgets the YouTube sign-in on this player
